## History

| date | prompt | windows with speech (mean / worst silence) | share of time with speech | latency p50 / p95 / max | model chose silence | lines heard / min | Verifier: both languages / EN only / TR only |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-23 | v3 | 97% / 64 s | 36% | 3.09 s / 4.77 s / 604.28 s (one hung call; the Foundry client now times out at 20 s) | 4% | 3.1 | 12 / 48 / 41 |
| 2026-10-23 | v4 (goal_effect fact, lead / level rule, "restored" and invented places banned) | 97% / 66 s | 33% | 2.71 s / 3.91 s / 10.05 s | 16% | 2.8 | 22 / 36 / 30 |

v4 is quieter: the model chose silence for 16% of segments (4% with v3) and the Verifier dropped 22 lines in both languages (12),
so 331 lines were heard instead of 369. The windows that have speech stay at 97%; the callouts fill the gaps.

Method: the server's commentator stream on a simulated clock (one match second per wall second, as at speed 1) and the client's one-voice rules, simplified (see the module doc). Narration durations are estimated from the English template text, callouts at 0.55 s per clip; commentator durations come from the real clips. The Verifier checks names and numbers against the segment facts and a list of invented details; it does not check every adjective.
